chunks: And it was narrated in another report:

"Indeed, wudu (ablution) upon wudu is light upon light, and whoever renews his wudu without a further hadath, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, renews his repentance without istighfar (seeking forgiveness)."

key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before acts of worship
key_terms.تَوْبَتَهُ: his repentance, meaning his turning back to Allah is renewed
key_terms.حَدَثٍ: a state of ritual impurity that nullifies wudu
key_terms.نُورٌ: light, meaning spiritual illumination and blessing

ai.seo_question: What is the merit of renewing wudu without having broken it?
ai.summary: This report praises renewing wudu (ablution) even when no new state of ritual impurity has occurred. It presents the act as an increase in spiritual light and links it to the renewal of tawbah (repentance) by Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.
